message: Fixed exp_study.py: totals() summed copies and ROI over every studied wallet instead of only the ones that pass the form bar, so the 2026-09-27 form study showed wallets in 6 -> 6 next to copies 3007 -> 2073 and ROI +3.2% -> +2.9% pulled from all 40 studied wallets, not just the 6. Added a regression test for the scope leak, full suite passed (1751 passed, 1 pre-existing unrelated failure in test_golive_month_one.py::test_a_disarm_that_cannot_be_written_stops_this_process that also fails on unmodified main in this sandbox, root can mkdir a nonexistent path where a non-root CI runner cannot, so its own OSError branch never fires), pushed to main.
evidence: study 2026-09-27-form-c2308d97: wallets in 6 -> 6 (stay 5, enter 1, leave 1); copies 3007 -> 2073; ROI at their price +3.2% -> +2.9%

2026-09-27 analyst wake: 3007 to 2073 copies and +3.2% to +2.9% ROI in the form study are summed over all 40 studied wallets while the wallet count is filtered to the in-form 6, so the headline mixes scopes and the true in-form ROI is +8.3% to +10.8%
